name: Busyness
overview: Scripture calls believers to pause from relentless activity and trust wholly in the Lord rather than their own efforts, as seen in Psalms 46:10 and Proverbs 3:5. It warns against the futility of anxious labor and encourages reliance on God's provision and rest, exemplified in Psalms 127:2 and Isaiah 55:1. Believers are urged to examine their priorities and seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, promising that all other needs will be met, as taught in Haggai 1:5 and Matthew 6:33.
